horses.spotlight_comment: Most of the runners are handicap newcomers, many of whom could prove capable of further progress. Improving COSMIC CONNECTION made a successful switch to handicap level last time and is probably still ahead of the assessor. Well-bred Wilstar is the narrow second choice, ahead of notable juvenile Minella Yoga and one who ties in with him, namely Secret Sniper. Skelton first string Kadastral has to be respected, while not many others can be comfortably ruled out in a deep handicap.[Steve Boow] Page 3 spotlightsandown 25.04.26

horses.spotlight_comment: The drop back to 2m didn't pay dividends at Aintree but PALAMON appeared to have plenty in hand when landing a big punt over 2m4f at Bangor two starts ago and is taken to overcome a 10lb higher mark today. Calimystic has made a bright start to his chasing career and is an obvious danger, while Go West can feature if back on song after his Grade 2 disappointment.[Chris Wilson] Page 9 spotlightsandown 25.04.26

The last race of the season can go to GNOMON. Toby Lawes's 5yo beat only three rivals when winning an Ascot maiden last month but he did so stylishly, and the form was given a good boost when the runner-up won a Ludlow handicap on Wednesday. Surrey Lord could still be well treated after his Kempton win on Boxing Day and is feared most. Favour And Fortune ran a big race at Aintree two weeks ago and is next on the list ahead of Across Earth, while the latter's long-absent stablemate Authorised Speed is well handicapped if he's still as good as he was.[Chris Wilson] Page 11
